name: unity-mcp
description: Unity Editor Control via MCP for NAAD project

unity.description: Unity Editor JSON-RPC endpoint for automated build, test, and verification commands

startup.instructions: Unity MCP server requires Unity Editor to be running with the com.ivanmurzak.unity.mcp package loaded. Start Unity Editor manually or use Unity CLI with the MCP plugin enabled.
startup.healthCheck: curl http://localhost:17890/mcp/rpc to verify endpoint is reachable
